title: Official RSS Feed
content: # RSS Feed I was pretty bored, so i thought of making my own rss feed. I did this because I started to use them. I think they are a pretty interesting way of centralizing a lot of websites and notifications. I use Inoreader (not sponsored), but any aggregator should work just fine. ## How do you subscribe to the dutu.dev RSS feed? 1. Go into your aggregator of choice 2. Add a feed using this link: https://dutu.dev/feed.xml This should be a pretty fast way of checking any new logs of mine without checking my website constantly. Thanks for reading my logs I didn't stop working on games btw :)

title: Astrodeck Release
content:
# Astrodeck Release

Yo, i released a new game, and uhh, i'm probably going to talk all alone in this log (who reads this 😭). I also made a video for this game and how i made it. It was made for a "contest" where the prize was going to Japan to build an arcade cabinet (those old big fridges where people played games). This event took place in August-November and the video took a while to make, cause i was lazy and i made some other games on the side (i'm also making a video about them). In the video i talk about how i made the game, and the fact that even though i did not get to go to Japan, i did win a raspberry pi. I'm thinking of making my own arcade cabinet using it (total copium). If you are interested to know, I also started working on this. So the next things to come will probably be :

 - New game with video (hope to release this soon)
 - Astrodeck mobile port
 - Arcade cabinet build video
 - A video about me learning to make games in some other ways
 
I find the last point interesting because making games this way (you will see how when i release that video) is really fun, a lot more challenging and i would like to make more games like this.

To end this log, i think that i will make videos a bit more "live" so i don't have to record my voice separately and maybe there is less to edit, but we'll see.

If you want to talk to me, don't forget to join my [discord server](https://dutu.dev/Log.php?log=OfficialDiscordServer), and go watch my videos.

xoxo, dutudev

title: New Website!
content:
# New Website
Welcome to my new website, here i will post different updates and an alternative to downloading my games. 

The layout of the website is pretty much inspired by Mike Klubnika's website.

I am thinking that maybe i will be releasing games here faster, but i'm not currently sure :sob:.
My games will still be up on itch so i won't move entirely to this website.
But i thought that maybe this is a pretty good way to connect to my community (nonexistent for now).

I am also thinking of what I'll be posting on here.
I'll probably write about the progress I'm making with my games, as posting a video is a long process
and posting once or twice a year is not enough.

Posting a video takes so much not because it's hard to make a game (i enjoy that part a lot and i can work with high efficiency),
but editing the video takes a lot of time to complete for some reason. Besides that, i am still in school and I don't have all day available
to work on what i would like.
